name: Morse Code
description: Translate text to Morse and back, play it as sound, flashlight or vibration, and tap your own code on a straight key.
prompt: A Morse code app: translate text to Morse and Morse to text, play it as a beep, with the flashlight or with vibration at an adjustable speed, a big straight key that decodes what you tap, and a chart of every letter and number.
author: gonzaroman
